page.overview:
Who is Mac iCar?

Mac iCar is a Piston Cup racecar who races for the team Apple in the movie Cars.

"Mac iCar likes things clean and simple. He doesn't go for the flashy colors, and gaudy stickers that adorn some of his fellow racers. He prefers a simple sleek design, and feels this creates a bold statement, one that says, "I think different.""

He spends most of the race behind Dale Earnhardt, Jr. in around 30th place. He is mainly seen when The King overtakes him after the race restarts. At the end of the race, he is seen near the back of the pack.

Mac iCar has so far only been released in the "Motor Speedway of the South" set in the Cars Die-Cast Line.
